audit.whatIsWrong: The page's whole plan is 'bank his combo into Indestructible' and never mentions that empowered Ruthless Predator DESTROYS damage shields.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'If Renekton has more than 50 Fury, he slashes his target three times, destroying damage shields on the target, dealing high physical damage, and stunning them for 1.5 seconds' (0.75s unempowered), 16/14/12/10/8s. That is the single most important interaction in the matchup — your shield-bank is deleted rather than absorbed if you hold it.
audit.corrected: Cash Indestructible into the heal BEFORE an empowered W lands; commit only once his Fury bar is spent.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers read Renekton / Renekton / Skill x5. The packet chart over 3017 games reads Renekton / Skill / Mordekaiser x5, on a 54.38% win rate. The tone is also the HARD red while diff says FAV.
audit.why: The page's own whys agree with the packet: whys[1] says level 2 'still trades even', whys[2] onward all describe you out-grinding a champion with zero sustain.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-6 flipped in BOTH layers as one atomic group -> Skill, Mordekaiser x5, plus the tone and the 'Hard matchup' wording.

audit.why: His spike is levels 1-2 on a banked Fury bar; yours are level 3, level 6 (Realm of Death, 140s at rank 1) and first item, and he falls off. Dominus is 120/100/80s and only grants health plus an aura, so it does not restore his laning burst.
audit.corrected: Left as written; the chart rows now match.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal guidance despite the matchup being decided by extended trades.
audit.why: Cull the Meek heals him every 7s and heals more above 50 Fury, so Grievous Wounds timing decides the grind your kit is trying to force.

edits.before: Hard matchup — difficulty 7/10, Renekton carry threat 8/10.
edits.after: Favoured matchup — difficulty 7/10, Renekton carry threat 8/10.

edits.before: - Renekton Ruthless Predator (Stun): matchup-defining — Empowered = long stun. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Renekton Ruthless Predator: Empowered strike; with Fury it stuns longer — his all-in lockdown. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Renekton Ruthless Predator (W): matchup-defining — 16s at rank 1; above 50 Fury it stuns 1.5s instead of 0.75s AND destroys your Indestructible shield, so cash the shield into a heal before it lands, then commit on the empty bar.

edits.before: Empowered = long stun. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Empowered W stuns 1.5s and is 16s at rank 1 — commit once it goes.

edits.before: Burning your answer for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Empowered W stuns 1.5s and destroys your shield — cash W before it hits.

edits.before: Whiffing Q into the wave and trading with no passive stacks — un-isolated Obliterate hits soft, and without Darkness Rise you lose most even exchanges.
edits.after: Renekton heals off Cull the Meek every 7s — bring Grievous Wounds, or his chip sustain undoes the whole extended trade your kit is forcing.

edits.before: With Q + W + E online you bank his fury combo into Indestructible, recast to heal, and start out-grinding a champion with zero sustain.
edits.after: With Q+W+E online you out-grind a champion with thin sustain — but his empowered W destroys shields, so cash Indestructible before it lands.

edits.before: Land empowered W (point-click stun) into a fury-empowered Q heal to chunk you while you have no Darkness Rise stacks or banked shield
edits.after: Land empowered W to stun 1.5s and destroy your Indestructible shield, then fury-Q to heal off you while your aura is not yet stacked

notes: The decisive interaction was absent: empowered Ruthless Predator (above 50 Fury) DESTROYS damage shields, which is precisely what the page told the player to bank and hold. It also doubles the stun from 0.75s to 1.5s. Correct play is to cash Indestructible into its heal before the empowered W lands. The chart also disagreed with a 3017-game packet in six rows while the page's own whys already read the other way, and the page carried the HARD red tone plus a 'Hard matchup' final line against a 54.38% win rate and a FAV diff — all proposed together. Not asserted (kits do not cover it): whether the shield-destroy also removes the pending heal from an already-banked Indestructible, and whether Renekton can Slice and Dice out of Realm of Death's cast animation.
